gloss: many times; repeatedly; over and over

definitions.gloss: many times; repeatedly; over and over again
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something happens or is done numerous times. Emphasizes repetition, often implying persistence or frustration.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も{言|い}ったでしょう。
examples.english: I've told you many times, haven't I?

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も{練習|れんしゅう}してやっとできるようになった。
examples.english: After practicing over and over, I finally got it.

examples.japanese: あの{映画|えいが}は{何度|なんど}も{見|み}たけれど、{毎回|まいかい}{新|あたら}しい{発見|はっけん}がある。
examples.english: I've seen that movie many times, but every time I discover something new.

notes:
Composed of {何度|なんど} (how many times) and the particle も (even, also), giving the sense of "as many times as..." — i.e., many times. One of the most common expressions for describing repetition in everyday Japanese.

USAGE:
Extremely common in both spoken and written Japanese. Can express positive persistence ({何度|なんど}も{挑戦|ちょうせん}した — tried many times) or exasperation ({何度|なんど}も{言|い}った — I've said it many times). The related expression {何度|なんど}でも means "no matter how many times" and is more emphatically unlimited.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {何度|なんど}も{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す — to repeat over and over
- {何度|なんど}も{挑戦|ちょうせん}する — to try many times
- {何度|なんど}も{確認|かくにん}する — to check repeatedly
- {何度|なんど}も{何度|なんど}も — again and again and again (emphatic)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {何回|なんかい}も — many times (interchangeable, slightly more casual)
- {繰|く}り{返|かえ}し — repeatedly (more formal, often written)
- {度々|たびたび} — frequently, often (more formal, polite nuance)
